title: Add unit tests for Face3

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Adds comprehensive unit tests for the `Face3` class (`core/math/face3.h`), which currently has no test coverage.                                                                      
                                                                                             
  ## Tests cover                                                                             
  - **Construction** — default and parameterized constructors                                
  - **Degenerate detection** — collinear points, duplicate vertices                          
  - **Area calculation** — unit triangle, scaled, degenerate                                 
  - **Plane extraction** — clockwise and counter-clockwise winding                           
  - **Ray intersection** — hit, miss, parallel, behind            
  - **Segment intersection** — through face, too short, miss                                 
  - **Closest point** — interior projection, nearest vertex, nearest edge, on-face           
  - **Split by plane** — split into pieces, entirely one side, degenerate guard              
  - **AABB intersection** — both `intersects_aabb` and `intersects_aabb2` variants           
  - **Projection & support** — `project_range` with/without transform, `get_support` for face/vertex-aligned normals                                                                
  - **AABB extraction** — `get_aabb` bounds correctness                                      
  - **String conversion**                                                                    
                                                                                             
  Includes `test_face3.md` documenting every test case and its rationale.
                                                                                             
  Contributes to #43440.
